title: Correct Term Symbols
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct term symbols for all ten elements listed.

title: Principle Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the principles used to determine the term symbols, including the concepts of spin and orbital angular momentum.

title: Aufbau Principle
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the Aufbau principle in determining the electron configurations for each element.

title: Symmetry Considerations
description: Important Criteria: The student should address the symmetry of the wave functions and how it affects the selection of term symbols.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect assignment of total spin or orbital angular momentum.
